questions.stem: In the parse tree of `id + id * id` for the usual expression grammar, which operator is applied first?
options: Multiplication, because its node is deeper in the tree
They are applied at the same time
It depends on the values of the ids
questions.explain: Higher-precedence operators sit lower in the tree and are evaluated before the nodes above them. The grammar, not the left-to-right position or the values, decides this.

questions.stem: How many tokens does the lexical analyser produce for the line `x = 3 + y`?
questions.explain: The tokens are x, =, 3, + and y. Spaces are skipped.

questions.stem: For the grammar S → aB | c, what is FIRST(S)?
questions.explain: FIRST(S) holds the first terminal each production can start with. S → aB starts with a and S → c starts with c.
